# trending.md
A dense trending information listing optimized for agentic web search. Markdown-first. Updated every 15 minutes.

## Feeds (English)
- Latest: https://trending.md/feed/latest.md (today's trending items, ranked by velocity)
- Archive: https://trending.md/feed/2026-08-11.md | https://trending.md/feed/2026-08-10.md | https://trending.md/feed/2026-08-09.md

## Feeds (中文 / Chinese)
- Latest: https://trending.md/zh/feed/latest.md
- Archive: https://trending.md/zh/feed/2026-08-11.md | https://trending.md/zh/feed/2026-08-10.md | https://trending.md/zh/feed/2026-08-09.md

## About
- EN: https://trending.md/en/about.md (project description + agent consumption guide)
- ZH: https://trending.md/zh/about.md (项目说明 + 智能体使用指南)

## Archive
- EN: https://trending.md/en/archive/index.md (full archive listing)
- ZH: https://trending.md/zh/archive/index.md (全部归档列表)

## Optional
